response.what_it_is: AFFF (Aqueous Film-Forming Foam) fire-fighting concentrate drum
hidden_risks: Whether the chemical is expired or degraded
Whether the drum is actually full or partially used
Seal integrity under the plastic wrap
response.best_proof: A close-up photo of the batch number, manufacture/expiry date, and unbroken seal on the cap.
response.failure_mode: Mistaking the specialized chemical concentrate drum for a standard empty plastic water/oil drum.
